changes.result: Confirmed source gap in two existing read paths. readCodexActiveRuntime previously discarded activeTurnId/nativeLastTurn after native thread/read; it now performs the adapter's existing exact thread/turns/list read for each exact loaded active thread, publishes fresh turnId/status when available, drops stale cached turn metadata, and sets nativeTurnStateUnavailable plus a partial snapshot receipt when exact turn read fails. Public agentInfoResult now fills an idle direct Codex read from the same existing listActiveSessions projection only when direct metadata has no turn identity, preserving existing meta (including sourceRoute/HumanStop fields). RED: tests/session-info-context.test.ts -t 'fills missing exact native activity' failed with returned session.idle and no activeTurnId/nativeLastTurn. RED for active projection: tests/codex-active-runtime.test.ts -t 'exact native in-progress turn' returned only loaded-thread metadata. GREEN: npx vitest run --root . --config vitest.config.ts tests/codex-active-runtime.test.ts tests/codex-app-server.test.ts tests/session-info-context.test.ts — 85 passed, 1 skipped; npx tsc --noEmit and git diff --check passed. Scoped source commit 8b3bebe7fb448ce2d348825c74b189af7bd17017 on origin/main; paths src/adapters/codex-active-runtime.ts, src/mcp-tools/handlers.ts, tests/codex-active-runtime.test.ts, tests/session-info-context.test.ts. Runtime was not installed or changed. Remaining acceptance: CI-owned install, then read the same public session_info and verify exact active turn/status; no runtime mutation or native send performed.
